Imagine what you could do here. The people here at Apple don’t just create products — they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. As an Apple Channel Store Advisor, you will showcase your ambitious spirit as you take a lead role in supporting the sales, merchandising, and operations of an Apple Shop within a partner reseller store. As a dynamic leader, business manager, and influencer, you will encourage our partner’s staff through your forward-thinking style, love for technology, and passion for Apple. Through your influence, you will grow Apple business in the multi-branded store by providing excellent customer service, conducting product demonstrations to customers, and training partner staff while ensuring all our merchandising standards are met. In this position, your work schedule will be based on business needs and will require you to work 37.5 hours per week, including evenings and Saturdays. This is a fixed-term position (approximately 14 moths).

Description

In this role, you will: - Represent Apple within a single partner store and help customers develop relationships with our brand. - Share your in-depth knowledge on Apple products directly to customers, work closely with partners, and create new owners of our products. - Provide an amazing customer experience by showcasing our products, accessories, and services. - Proactively seek opportunities to expand awareness for new and existing customers. - Leverage your curiosity for technology and stay up to date on initiatives impacting the customer journey. - Ensure that all Apple fixtures, product exposures, and merchandising elements in the store are up to date and maintained according to Apple's standards. - Provide daily care and inspection according to guidelines and escalate issues for timely and effective resolution. - Educate customers by delivering individual and group product demonstrations, sharing the latest sales promotions, and encouraging adoption of the Apple platform.

Minimum Qualifications

• Minimum of 2 years of related experience.

• Passion for helping customers and partners understand how Apple technology can enrich lives.

• Curiosity for continuous learning and eagerness to share knowledge with others.

• Outstanding customer focus.

• Excellent communication skills.

• Ability to educate and inspire others.

• Solid relationship building skills with the ability to become a trusted business partner at a single point of sale.

• Fluency in Danish and ability to communicate in English.

Preferred Qualifications

• High level of integrity, trust, and accountability.

• Strong self motivation and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.

• Effective time management including ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize tasks.

• Ambition for driving sales results and recommending Apple solutions is desirable.

• Background in direct sales or solution-based selling is a plus.

SAS is expanding! We are pleased to announce that applications are now open for our Fall 2026 Cabin Crew courses.

SAS is expanding - connecting people, cultures, and destinations like never before, and inviting you to be part of it.

We are now looking for more colleagues who want to be a part of this journey.

As part of the SAS Cabin Crew team, you will meet people from all around the world. You will take pride in creating a safe and welcoming experience for Scandinavia’s travelers by ensuring onboard safety, delivering great service and sales on SAS flights. The role involves varying schedules, requiring a high level of flexibility and adaptability in your day-to-day work.

SAS believes that diversity makes the team stronger. By working together, SAS fosters an inclusive workplace where everyone can feel valued and where every journey and every person matter.

Minimum Requirements

• 
Minimum age 18 years.

• 
Height at least 160 cm (without shoes).

• 
Completed education to a minimum level of high school or equivalent level.

• 
Minimum 2 years of work experience in a customer-facing role. Hospitality, sales and service experience is considered an advantage.

• 
Fluent in English language (Berlitz level B2/gym. Min. B).

• 
Strong swimming skills.

• 
Able to comply with uniform regulations: Visible tattoos are allowed below the neck, excluding hands and chest. One small, discreet tattoo, no larger than 1,5cm is, however, acceptable on the hand and right behind the ear (not extending onto back of head or neck). Visible tattoos should not be offensive or religious motives.

• 
Valid EU passport allowing free travel worldwide.

• 
Eligible to live and work permanently in Denmark.

• 
You must be available to work scheduled shifts, including weekends and public holidays.

• 
Able to get to Copenhagen Kastrup Airport (CPH) within 1h and 20 min on standby duties.

Addition requirements for experienced Cabin Crew

• 
Valid EASA Attestation and Medical.

• 
Minimum of one year of continuous experience as Senior Cabin Crew, within the past five years.

Security & Medical Requirements

• 
Employment requires an approved Security Assessment which includes security interview, 5-year-background check, reference check and exhaustive police certificate/clean record.

• 
Approved/passed training course, and that you meet the company’s requirements set for cabin crew.

• 
Good physical and mental health, as well as good vision (+/- 0.7 with or without corrections). Can be health approved according to EASA Regulations. To read more about medical certification for Cabin Crew, click here.

• 
Employment also requires completed and passed drug and alcohol tests (blood and urine samples).

• 
Our premises and work are located within the airport security-related area; therefore you must be approved by the aviation authorities.

• 
All the steps above must be approved before commencing the Cabin Crew training.

**Personal Qualities
**You are someone who:

• 
Has a strong service mindset and connects naturally with people through strong interpersonal and communication skills.

• 
Contributes to a safe, efficient, and welcoming onboard environment on every flight.

• 
Maintain a professional, calm, and solution-oriented attitude in all situations.

• 
Are a strong team player and adaptable, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

• 
Resilient and can manage irregular hours and changing schedules.

**

SAS Culture**

At Scandinavian Airlines, the focus is on caring for people, delivering exceptional experiences for travelers, and advancing the transition toward more sustainable aviation. This is guided by the iCARE framework, reflecting a commitment to Inspiration, Collaboration, Accountability, Recognition, and Execution in everything they do.

As a future team member, candidates can expect to be part of a collaborative environment where shared goals drive performance, contributions are recognized, and successes are celebrated. The organization places strong emphasis on safe, sustainable, and punctual operations, while actively working to reduce environmental impact and transform for the future

SAS is proud to operate through three owned subsidiaries; SAS Scandinavia, SAS Connect and SAS Link. We are excited to offer exciting career opportunities, including permanent positions and employment in 100%, 80% and 0% Resource pool. Although you might have a preference, we always give the option of the available position we have at the time.

If you meet the above qualifications and would like to join SAS Cabin Crew team, we encourage you to submit your application by clicking “Apply Now”.

Recruitment will take place based on operational needs. The first courses are planned for fall and winter 2026/2027. Due to high number of applications, response time may be longer than usual. You are always welcome to contact us at cc@aapaviation.com.

Our Recruitment Journey

• 
Application and online assessment: You will complete a set of application questions along with a video introduction where you have the chance to showcase yourself and to stand out. Once submitted, we will review your skills and experience.

• 
Assessment Center: If your application is successful, the next step will be an invitation to attend our assessment day.

• 
Post Assessment: Before employment can be offered you will need to complete various checks including reference checks, criminal record checks and security clearance.

• 
Pre-employment checks: Successful candidates will need to complete a medical examination and drug- and alcohol test.

• 
Cabin Crew Training: If you have passed all the requirements, you can start our 4-week Cabin Crew training program which will prepare you for a career in the sky.

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable. The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

• 
Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• 
Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• 
Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• 
Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• 
Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

• 
Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• 
Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• 
Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• 
Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

• 
Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• 
Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

• 
Experience with GPU programming and image processing systems (Metal, OpenCL, CUDA or similar).

• 
Experience with regression testing across many hardware devices, e.g., device labs, device farms, or fleet-based test automation.

As Marketing Manager, Nordics, you will be responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy and annual marketing plan for one of our business channels across the Nordic region, in line with company objectives, regional priorities, and global strategy.

You will play a key role in accelerating business growth by identifying market opportunities, driving customer engagement, strengthening customer adoption, and delivering impactful marketing initiatives that support our commercial objectives.

Working closely with commercial, clinical, and regional marketing teams, you will translate customer insights into effective marketing programs that drive customer success and long-term business performance.

You will report to the Senior Marketing Manager, Nordics and be based in Copenhagen, with regular travel across the Nordic region.

Role expectations

Strategic Growth & Business Development

• Lead the strategic growth of your assigned business channel across the Nordics by identifying and executing high-impact growth opportunities in alignment with EMEA strategy and in close collaboration with the commercial organization and Senior Marketing Manager.

• Proactively represents the Nordic region and our customers by providing market insights, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and business analytics to support new product development and global strategy.

• Identify local growth opportunities and champion initiatives that support business expansion beyond regional marketing plans.

• 
Focus on end-to-end excellence across products, services, and customer experiences while maintaining a broad market perspective and identifying future opportunities.

• 
Generate actionable customer, market, and competitive insights to shape commercial priorities and marketing investments.

Marketing Planning & Execution

• Develop and execute the annual marketing plan for the assigned business channel, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives, company strategy, regional priorities, and global direction.

• Lead and execute channel marketing initiatives, including congresses, summits, customer events, speaker programs, educational activities, marketing playbooks, digital campaigns, and customer engagement programs.

• Own the end-to-end planning and delivery of key initiatives by defining timelines, responsibilities, materials, agency deliverables, stakeholder briefings, field team alignment, attendance where relevant, and post-activity follow-up.

• Champion regional and central marketing programs locally in close collaboration with sales, clinical, and regional teams, ensuring activities are translated into clear and practical execution for the Nordic markets.

• Use analytics and insights, including campaign ROI, customer reimbursement trends, market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer feedback, to continuously optimize marketing performance and improve future activities.

• Support successful product launches, commercialization strategies, and customer adoption initiatives.

KOL & Customer Engagement

• 
Build and maintain strong relationships with KOLs, speakers, key customers, institutions, and professional associations across the Nordics.

• Partner with external stakeholders to deliver educational, scientific, and professional initiatives that strengthen customer engagement and thought leadership.

• Identify, brief, and support speakers and KOLs for congresses, educational programs, and customer-facing activities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner closely with Commercial, Clinical, Finance, Education, Regional Marketing, and local country teams to ensure aligned execution and measurable business impact.

• Provide channel expertise, customer insights, campaign materials, messaging, and practical guidance to support successful local execution.

• 
Build stakeholder alignment across functions and markets to drive implementation of strategic initiatives.

Digital Marketing & Innovation

• Utilize digital communication platforms, marketing technologies, AI-enabled tools, automation solutions, and analytics platforms to deliver and optimize marketing activities.

• Deliver integrated omnichannel campaigns that enhance customer engagement throughout the customer journey building the future of Digital dentistry.

• Explore innovative approaches to customer engagement and continuously evaluate emerging marketing trends and leverage EMEA and global best practices

Training & Capability Building (consider erasing – repetition)

• Train and educate country stakeholders on relevant aspects of the business channel, customer journey, brand strategy, products, and marketing initiatives.

• Develop training materials and supporting collateral to enable effective execution across local teams and share best practices, customer insights, and market learnings to support continuous improvement across the Nordic organization.

What we're looking for

Experience

• 4+ years of relevant experience in B2B or healthcare marketing, preferably within the medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or Fast-Moving Consumer Healthcare (FMCH) industries.

• Demonstrated experience developing and implementing successful marketing strategies and campaigns.

• Experience working cross-functionally with commercial, clinical, and field-based teams.

• Experience managing agencies, events, and external partners.

• Proven ability to use data and insights to drive decision-making and business results.

• Hands-on experience with congress participation, event execution, agency coordination, customer-facing activities, digital campaigns, marketing materials, and follow-up processes.

Skills

• Strong strategic mindset and commercial acumen.

• Ability to identify growth opportunities and translate insights into actionable initiatives.

• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

• Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.

• Ability to work independently and navigate a matrix organization.

• Comfortable balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution.

• Proactive problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.

• Results-oriented and customer-focused approach.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

**

Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related discipline is required; a Master’s degree is considered an advantage.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, who will like to join our Tech team in Copenhagen!

We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to join our Tech team in Copenhagen. Someone who's excited about where software development is heading and wants to help shape how we build with AI.

As a member of our Tech team, you'll be an essential part of developing digital products together with our clients and the team around you. Since we're an agency, we work with a wide range of clients, typically in focused sprints where we build new products or improve products we've built with them before. Our stack is TypeScript with Next.js and React at its core, extending into backend services, APIs and integrations as projects demand.

We're operating in a time of agentic engineering. AI agents are changing how software gets built, and we embrace that: we use agentic tools to ship faster and build AI-powered features into client products. At the same time, we know that reaching the quality we aim for means sticking to the fundamentals of good software development. Agents amplify good engineering, they don't replace it. We're looking for someone with strong fundamentals in architecture, code quality and judgment, who can put these new tools to work without compromising on craft.

We have an excellent team across our Copenhagen, Montreal, London and Toronto offices. We'll throw challenges at you, teach you new things, learn from you, and make sure we grow together toward our ambition of setting new and higher standards for the web.

Check out some of our work HERE.

Key tasks

• 
Shape, build and improve digital products end to end, from frontend (Next.js/React) to backend services, APIs and integrations

• 
Inspire adoption of agentic engineering: use AI coding agents in daily work and share learnings and insights with a team that explores and grows together

• 
Build AI-powered features and agentic systems into client products, such as MCP/LLM integrations, automations and intelligent product experiences

• 
Take technical ownership on client projects: architecture decisions, technical direction, and quality

•

Assisting with documenting findings and communicating observations to developers and product teams

• 
Supporting the maintenance of test documentation and quality-related processes

• 
Participating in team meetings and collaborating with colleagues across development and product teams

• 
Contributing to quality initiatives that help us continuously improve our products

You will gain hands-on experience with software development processes, quality assurance practices, defect reporting, and modern collaboration tools used in professional product development environments.

Job requirements

Who We Are Looking For

We imagine that you:

• 
Are currently enrolled in a higher education program

• 
Have an interest in software, technology, or digital products

• 
Enjoy learning new systems and tools

• 
Are structured and pay attention to details

• 
Like collaborating with others and communicating your observations clearly

• 
Take responsibility for your tasks and are comfortable working independently when needed

• 
Have good English communication skills, both written and spoken

Most importantly, you are curious, motivated to learn, and enjoy understanding how things work.

It Is a Plus If You Have Experience With

Don't worry if you don't tick all the boxes. These are simply nice-to-have skills that you can also learn while working with us:

• 
Basic understanding of websites, web applications, or software development

• 
Experience working with technical tools or systems

• 
Interest in software testing, quality assurance, or product quality

• 
Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar collaboration tools

What We Offer

At Trackman, you will join a team of passionate colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow professionally.

We offer:

• 
Practical experience within software quality assurance and product development

• 
Mentorship and support from experienced QA professionals

• 
Insight into how innovative software products are developed and maintained

• 
A flexible student position that works alongside your studies

• 
A modern workplace with excellent facilities at our headquarters in Hørsholm

• 
Great colleagues, social activities, and plenty of opportunities to learn and develop

The position is expected to be 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams and study commitments. The role is primarily based at our office in Hørsholm.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Are you our new digital marketing & content creation intern?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a digital marketing & content creation intern to help us with marketing and branding.

longvé is a dynamic and innovative jewellery start-up located in the heart of Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv. We offer a fresh digital approach to the jewellery industry, with our digital platform empowering customers to design their own jewellery. We offer the customers classic customisable designs, handcrafted quality and sustainable sourcing of recycled materials, all at a transparent and fair price. The company launched at the end of 2022.

We are currently seeking an digital marketing/content creator intern. This is a unique opportunity to impact a newly launched brand, and get a steep learning curve, while working in a high-paced start-up environment, where we make sure to have fun.

Besides being enrolled in a study program within marketing, social media, content production, creative or multimedia design, the ideal candidate should have:

• Ambitions within digital marketing and content production

• A sublime eye for detail and aesthetics

• Experience with using the Adobe suite (experience within other platforms such as Lightroom is also a benefit)

• A passion for editing work and acknowledge that the details are super important

• A team player mindset and appreciate getting constructive feedback

• Excellent writing skills in both Danish and English (fluent in English)

• The ability to be self-leading and take ownership of own tasks

What you will do:

• Produce content (videos and photos) for organic use across social media

• Be part of planning the campaigns and come up with creative ideas for content

• Create graphic material for social content, social ads and other digital channels

• Editing photos and videos from photoshoots

• Support in planning and coordinating photoshoots

• Assist with social media management and execution

• Assist with setting up content for email campaigns and programs

• Ad-hoc marketing tasks

What you get:

• Hands-on experience with building and activating a new digital brand

• Insights into and experience with the start-up world

• Possibility to build up portfolio material

• Autonomous working schedule where you can influence ways of working

• Working closely with the founders and joining a team that values great energy, good humour and strong collaboration

The start date and length of the internship will be agreed with the selected candidate. The internship may lead to a potential job opportunity based on the fit, skills, and growth of the business.

We promise to give you hands-on experience as well as an exciting playground for you to test, develop and execute great ideas. If you find this an exciting opportunity, please send your CV and resume, with some examples you have done, and the style you like personally. Send to Katja Schjølin at katja@longve.com.
